title: Let slow downloads finish and judge a tool-free local recovery answer like the first attempt
goal: Downloads: each transfer call keeps its fixed total timeout, but only calls that add no resumable bytes spend the retry budget, so a slow link completes. Recovery: when a mission captured nothing to cite, the local in-process rung self-cites its inference receipt and is shown with the first attempt's uncited warning; captured evidence must still be cited and cloud prose stays strict.
acceptance: A download needing five cut-short calls completes under a two-stall budget
Consecutive stalls exhaust the budget; progress refunds it
A tool-free local recovery answer is accepted with the uncited warning while the strict gate still rejects the same uncited prose
A mission with captured evidence is not treated as tool-free
Native combined-tree acceptance and qualified fresh 8 GiB Windows VM journey remain required before production promotion
